in_hebrew.name: Page
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Page הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘pagos’, which means ‘servant’ or ‘bearer’. In the New Testament, Saint Paul is referred to as a servant of God or a servant of Christ, making the name Page a symbol of dedication and service in the Christian faith.
